test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Rajani borrowed an amount of ₹11,550 at an interest rate of 10% per annum, compounded annually. She repaid the entire amount with interest in two equal instalments, the instalments being paid at the end of the first and the second years from the date of borrowing. What is the value of each instalment, if interest is computed on reducing balance?
solution:
**Formula used**

Compound interest = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ - P

**Calculation**

Let the value of each instalment be x

Total amount after 2 years = 11,550[1 + 0.1]²

Rajani pays the 1st instalment at the end of one year and 2ⁿd instalment at the end of two years.

∴ 11,550[1 + 0.1]² = x[1 + 0.1] + x

⇒ 11,550 × 1.21 = 2.1x

⇒ x = 6655

The value of each instalment is Rs. 6655.
